probes.question: True or false: wombats leave cube-shaped faeces.
Wombats arrange their droppings to do what?

image.alt: An adult common wombat walking on bare ground with a blurred green background

body.question: Which animal leaves cube-shaped droppings?
body.reveal: Wombats leave distinctive cube-shaped faeces. They arrange these to mark territories and attract mates, and it is believed that the cubic shape makes them more stackable and less likely to roll. In 2019, this was the subject of the Ig Nobel Prize for Physics.
